sources.citation: Wambaliau, Theresia. 2004. Draft Laporan Survei pada Bahasa Murkim di Papua, Indonesia. 34 pp. Jayapura: SIL Indonesia (ms., 'to appear in SIL Electronic Survey Reports')
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only primary data on Murkim (sociolinguistic survey with Milki and Mot village wordlists, pp. 22–28 dialects per Wikipedia). Glottolog types it overview/wordlist/socling, so a stress statement is unlikely, but it is the sole place a transcriber's note on stress could exist. Held by SIL Indonesia and in Hammarström's bibliography (papua/); sil.org could not be reached by automated download.
